scope: All 196 validated full episodes in the eleven completed declared batches. Original benchmark labels are retained alongside prerequisite attainment.
interpretation: Preserve original benchmark success and physical-violation labels. A success with no observed prerequisite and a nonaccepting, non-doomed final monitor state does not demonstrate closure/lid placement or satisfaction of strong-until on a completed finite trace. Goal held-intersection and absence of a detected violation are distinct from the complete natural-language task. This audit does not redefine benchmark outcomes.

local_source_audit.goal_check: build_goal_checker selects GoalRegionChecker when a goal region is present. The recorded goal mode in both cases is held_intersection.
local_source_audit.termination: benchmark advances the monitor, then checks instantaneous goal success and ends after the consecutive-success threshold, without requiring a final accepting monitor state.
local_source_audit.violation: RuntimeSafetyMonitor latches a violation only on a doomed state; violated returns whether a first violation step exists. The two safe-labelled examples finish neither accepting nor doomed.
